invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null iterator, either from Collections.singletonList(...).iterator() or from new JavaLazyInsertIterable(...).
If recordItr had at least one element, result is always a JavaLazyInsertIterable instance.
If recordItr is empty, result yields exactly one empty list.
If recordItr has data, result is never Collections.singletonList(...).
idPfx is used as a parameter and possibly must be non-null in the method logic.
